en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a uniformed cavalryman on horseback holding a lance with a small flag. The rider wears a traditional military dress uniform with a plume on his hat, and the horse is fully tacked. They stand in front of a simple wall with a low stone base. The image is bordered by a wide blank margin; at the bottom in red script is the word 'Grossenhain.' There is also small vertical printer information along the left side and a handwritten red number at the lower right.
